# volcenginecc_waf_bot_analyse_protect_rule (Data Source)

Data Source schema for Volcengine::WAF::BotAnalyseProtectRule



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `accurate_group` (Attributes) Advanced condition group. Do not include this field if not enabled or if the list is empty. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accurate_group))
- `action_after_verification` (Number) Follow-up actions after challenge verification succeeds. Applies only when ActionType is 6 (JS challenge), 7 (human verification), or 10 (proof of work). 1: Block; 2: Monitor.
- `action_type` (Number) Action to execute. 0: Observe; 1: Rate limit (supported only in frequency limit scenario, i.e., StatisticalType=1); 2: Block; 6: JS challenge; 7: CAPTCHA; 10: Proof of work; 11: Drop.
- `cron_confs` (Attributes Set) Periodic cycle configuration list. Supported only for frequency limit rules with StatisticalType=1. Threshold switching is specified by crontab. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cron_confs))
- `effect_time` (Number) Action effective duration in seconds, range 30~86400. Required when creating or updating rules except for ActionType=1 (rate limiting).
- `enable` (Number) Rule switch. 0: Off; 1: On.
- `exemption_time` (Number) Exemption time for human verification, JS challenge, or proof of work, in seconds. Range 30~3600. Applies only when ActionType is 6/7/10.
- `field` (String) Statistical object. Supports single or multiple fields, separated by commas. Maximum of 10 fields. Basic format is DataType:Value, for example HEADER:X-Forwarded-For, CLIENTIP, COOKIE:token, ARGS:device_id, JA3HASH.
- `host` (String) Domain name. The website domain to be protected. Make sure the domain has been added to the current WAF instance before calling.
- `name` (String) Rule name. Must start with Chinese/letter/number. Allows Chinese/letters/numbers/period (.)/underscore (_)/hyphen (-). Length 1~128 characters.
- `pass_ratio` (Number) JS challenge or CAPTCHA pass rate. Returned only when ActionType is 6/7/10.
- `path` (String) Request path to which the rule applies. You can specify an exact page path, match the entire site, or all paths under a directory (using wildcard *). The wildcard * can only appear at the end of the path.
- `path_threshold` (Number) Overall threshold for the current path. Effective only when StatisticalType=1. Range 1~300000.
- `project_name` (String) Project name, which is the project associated with the current resource. Only projects with permissions under the current identity can be associated.
- `rule_id` (String) Bot statistical protection rule ID.
- `rule_priority` (Number) Rule priority under the same path and advanced condition. Range 0~9, with 0 being the highest priority.
- `rule_tag` (String) Rule display ID. Frequency limit rule prefix is R (e.g., R000000018673); repeated statistics rule prefix is S (e.g., S000000018674).
- `single_proportion` (Number) Ratio threshold for a single statistical object. Enabled only when StatisticalType=3 (repeat ratio). Value range: [0, 1).
- `single_threshold` (Number) Threshold for the number of times per statistical object. Used only when StatisticalType=1. Range 1~300000.
- `statistical_duration` (Number) Statistical time window, in seconds. Frequency limit scenario (StatisticalType=1): 5~1800; repeat statistics scenario (StatisticalType=2/3): 1~60.
- `statistical_type` (String) Statistical method. "1": access frequency; "2": repeat count; "3": repeat ratio.
- `update_time` (String) Last update time of the rule.

<a id="nestedatt--accurate_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accurate_group`

Read-Only:

- `accurate_group_priority` (Number) Priority of advanced condition group. Not required for create/update; used only for list display.
- `accurate_rules` (Attributes Set) Sub-rule list in advanced conditions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--accurate_group--accurate_rules))
- `id` (Number) Advanced condition group ID. Not required for create/update operations; used only for list display.
- `logic` (Number) Logical relationship. 1: AND; 2: OR.

<a id="nestedatt--accurate_group--accurate_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `accurate_group.accurate_rules`

Read-Only:

- `http_obj` (String) Match object. Fixed objects automatically generate HttpObj by ObjType. Custom objects require specifying the Key in HttpObj, e.g., request.header.clientip, request.uri, request.queryargs.abc, request.header.custom-header, request.cookie.custom-cookie, etc.
- `obj_type` (Number) Enumeration of match object types. 0: request protocol; 1: request URI; 2: request method; 3: request path; 4: request parameters; 5: request header; 6: User-Agent; 7: Referer; 8: Cookie; 9: request body length; 10: request body format; 11: X-Forwarded-For; 12: client IP; 13: custom Args; 14: custom Header; 15: custom Cookie; 23: JA3 Hash; 25: Session-ID; 26: client fingerprint.
- `opretar` (Number) Enumeration of match operators. 0~5: size comparison; 6~11: substring match; 12~15: set match; 16: regex; 17~21: IP identification (only for request.header.clientip or custom objects); 23/24: include/exclude address group; 25/26: include/exclude geographic location; 27: include IP intelligence; 28/29: AS number belongs/does not belong.
- `property` (Number) Match attribute type enumeration. 0: Value; 1: StrLen; 2: Size; 3: Keys; 4: Version; 5: IP (used only for Operator=17~21); 6: Country.
- `value_string` (String) Match value. IP identification operations with Operator=17~21 do not involve match content and can be an empty string. For Operator=23~29, fill in according to the corresponding format (IP address group ID/region code/IP intelligence tag/ASN). For other operators, enter the actual match value.



<a id="nestedatt--cron_confs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cron_confs`

Read-Only:

- `crontab` (String) crontab expression. Recommended format: * <startHour>-<endHour> * * <weekList>, for example * 18-20 * * 1,2,3,4,5.
- `path_threshold` (Number) Total path threshold during the specified period. Value range: 1~300000.
- `single_threshold` (Number) Threshold for a single object during the specified period. Value range: 1~300000.
